metadata.title: OpenRouter Multimodal Generation Connector Configurations
metadata.description: 15 connection-configuration templates for calling image, video, and audio (speech/music/transcription) generation models through OpenRouter's unified API. Unlike the agent-persona templates in the companion files, these are technical connector configs: endpoint, auth, request/response shape, and key parameters — meant to be wired into an Integration Specialist / Feature Developer style agent that needs to call a generation model as a tool.
metadata.global_auth_notes: Provision keys from the OpenRouter dashboard (openrouter.ai/keys); name each key per environment/agent and set an optional credit limit. Store as an environment variable, never commit to source control. OpenRouter scans public repos for leaked keys and will notify you; rotate immediately if a key is exposed.
metadata.global_caveat: OpenRouter's model catalog, pricing, and exact endpoint paths change frequently. This file was built from OpenRouter's published docs and model-collection pages as of the research date; treat every model_id and endpoint here as a snapshot to verify against https://openrouter.ai/docs and https://openrouter.ai/models before relying on it in production, rather than as a permanently fixed reference.

connectors.name: Nano Banana Pro (Gemini 3 Pro Image)
connectors.description:
Google's top-tier multimodal image generation/editing model, built on Gemini 3 Pro's
    reasoning. Strong at prompt adherence for complex, multi-element scenes, accurate text
    rendering within images, and iterative image editing via input_references (e.g. "change
    the shirt color, keep everything else identical"). Best paired with an agent that needs
    to reason about composition before generating, since the model shares its parent LLM's
    instruction-following strength.

connectors.name: Nano Banana (Gemini 2.5 Flash Image)

    image editing loops (multiple back-and-forth refinement calls) where per-call cost and
    latency matter more than absolute peak fidelity. Good default for an agent doing rapid
    concept exploration or many small edits in sequence.

connectors.name: Veo 3.1
connectors.description:
Google's flagship text/image-to-video model, notable for generating synchronized
    audio alongside video (dialogue, sound effects, ambient noise) rather than silent clips.
    Best for an agent producing short cinematic or narrative clips where audio-visual
    coherence matters. Two lighter variants (veo-3.1-fast, veo-3.1-lite) trade quality for
    lower cost/latency.

request_template.prompt: A slow aerial shot flying over a misty forest at dawn, birds chirping

unsigned_urls: signed/download URL(s), populated once status == completed

key_parameters: prompt (required) — text description of desired video
resolution — e.g. 480p through 4K depending on model
frame_images — array of first/last-frame reference images
callback_url — webhook fired on job completion, alternative to polling
provider — object for routing/provider-specific passthrough options
connectors.async_behavior: asynchronous — POST returns a jobId; poll GET /api/v1/videos/{jobId} or supply callback_url until status=='completed', then download from unsigned_urls[0]
connectors.cost_notes: Video generation is priced per second of output and is typically the most expensive modality on OpenRouter; the -fast and -lite variants reduce cost.
connectors.caveats: Video generation is asynchronous and can take from tens of seconds to several minutes depending on model, duration, and resolution — always design the calling agent to submit the job, then poll or use callback_url rather than blocking synchronously. Confirm current models and per-second pricing at https://openrouter.ai/collections/video-models before use.

Google's music generation model capable of producing full-length songs with

    output quality/availability as less stable than GA models.

request_template.prompt: Upbeat indie-pop track with acoustic guitar, warm and optimistic mood

response_shape.audio_url_or_b64: generated music file reference, format per model docs

key_parameters: duration — target length in seconds (full-length for Pro tier)
connectors.async_behavior: likely asynchronous for full-length generation given render time — confirm current behavior in OpenRouter's audio-generation docs before building a synchronous caller
connectors.cost_notes: Preview-tier pricing; confirm commercial-use licensing terms for generated music before shipping it in a product.
connectors.caveats: Music-generation models are newer and more variable in duration limits (some cap at ~30 seconds for clip/preview tiers vs. full-length for 'pro' tiers) and licensing terms for commercial use — check the specific model's page at https://openrouter.ai/collections/audio-models and its provider's licensing terms before using output commercially. This is a preview model — re-verify its exact endpoint path and request schema against OpenRouter's live docs before production use, as preview APIs are more likely to change than GA ones.

connectors.name: Whisper Large v3
connectors.description:
OpenAI's Whisper large-v3 model for speech-to-text transcription, strong
    multilingual accuracy and robust to background noise/accents. Default choice for an
    agent that needs to transcribe meeting audio, voice notes, or call recordings; Google's
    chirp-3 (google/chirp-3) is a comparable alternative worth A/B testing for a given
    language/accent mix.
